definitions.usage: carry away as with a flood, pour out.
definitions.full: H2229. zaram [ זָרַם ] verb pour forth in floods, flood away (Assyrian zarâmu , overwhelm , VR 36, 57 c Dl Pr 73 & in Zim BP 119 ) — Qal Perfect 2masculine singular suffix זְרַמְתָּם Psa 90:5 thou floodest them with rain, sweepest them (men) away . Po. Perfect 3plural עָבוֺת מַ֫יִם זֹ֫רְמוּ Psa 77:18 the cloud masses (Che) poured forth water .
